summary: Allow an inherited schema-invalid release note to be repaired into a valid note while preserving immutability of valid notes and requiring a fresh PR classification.

schema.detail: No database schema or storage version changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rule or fleet coordination changes.

compatibility.detail: The PR upgrade-impact checker permits modification only when the fragment inherited from each integrated member's first parent fails the existing JSON or fragment schema validation and its replacement passes that same validation. A note repaired by one queue member is immutable for later members. Valid existing fragments remain immutable; deletion and renaming remain forbidden. Repairs do not replace the required fresh PR fragment or bypass coverage and version-transition checks. The inherited subject activity summary now uses the supported changed compatibility status rather than additive, retaining its impact details.

manual.detail: No operator action required. Future corrections to already valid release notes still require a new fragment.

recovery.detail: No runtime or stored-data changes to recover.
